name: リサンプリング検出
description: 検出します interpolation アーティファクト from image scaling, rotation, or skewing operations.
algorithm: Periodic Correlation Detection in Resampled Signals
mechanism: 分析します periodic 相関s introduced by resampling operations. When an image is scaled or rotated, interpolation creates detectable periodic パターン in pixel derivatives that can be revealed through スペクトル分析.
parameters: Analysis: EM algorithm, Radon transform projection, Derivative filter: [-1, 1], Spectrum: 64-point DFT
source: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP
useCase: Detecting geometric transformations applied during image スプライシング or composition

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP

strengths:
• スケーリング/回転の検出に高精度
• 理論的に確立されている
• リサンプリング係数を推定可能
• 異なる補間方法で動作
limitations:
• Requires large homogeneous regions
• May fail on heavily textured areas
• 計算集約的 EM fitting
• JPEG圧縮 can mask traces
